riasec.q1: I enjoy building, repairing, and working with concrete tools.
riasec.q2: I enjoy analyzing data, solving logical problems, and doing research.

riasec.q5: I enjoy leading projects, making decisions, and launching new initiatives.

spirits.hun_1: I find it easy to picture my ideal future and feel it is genuinely within reach.
spirits.hun_2: I often get excited by original ideas that push me to explore new paths.

spirits.zhi_1: I follow through on my decisions even when they become difficult or demand sacrifice.
spirits.zhi_2: I naturally look for a way to keep going, even when facing obstacles.

comeFunziona.subtitle: Three steps to find your professional direction with real data and validated psychological tools.
comeFunziona.heroSubtitle: A three-step approach combining scientific psychology, real market data, and an inner compass to help you choose with clarity.

steps.title: Take the test
steps.subtitle: 12 questions, less than 3 minutes
steps.description: The NorthStar test combines the RIASEC model — scientifically validated by over 60 years of research — with the Inner Compass of the Five Spirits. There are no right or wrong answers: the system measures your natural inclinations, not your knowledge.
steps.detail: The questions cover 6 dimensions of professional personality (Realistic, Investigative, Artistic, Social, Enterprising, Conventional) and 5 inner qualities (Presence, Vision, Instinct, Focus, Tenacity).

steps.title: Discover your profile
steps.subtitle: Your professional DNA
steps.description: The system processes your answers and generates a unique RIASEC profile — a combination of letters describing your dominant aptitudes — and an Inner Compass map with your five balanced spirits.
steps.detail: The RIASEC profile is used by universities, Fortune 500 companies and employment centers worldwide. The Inner Compass is an original NorthStar model that integrates dimensions of inner motivation.

steps.title: Explore your sectors
steps.subtitle: 3 personalized recommendations with real data
steps.description: The algorithm cross-references your profile with data from 21 professional sectors: salaries, market growth, AI automation risk and trends. You receive 3 sectors where your natural talent meets a real opportunity.
steps.detail: You can explore each sector, compare them, confirm your choice and access premium features (Wiki, Roadmap, Knowledge Graph) to chart your concrete path.

faq.a: Yes, the RIASEC + Inner Compass test and the 3 sector recommendations are completely free. No registration is required to complete the test. Premium features (personalized Wiki, detailed Roadmap, Knowledge Graph) require a subscription.

faq.q: How long does it take to complete the test?
faq.a: The full test takes about 3-5 minutes. There are 12 RIASEC questions and 15 Inner Compass questions (3 for each of the 5 spirits). You can answer at your own pace without pressure.

faq.q: Is the RIASEC model scientifically valid?
faq.a: Yes. The RIASEC model (also known as Holland's theory) was developed by psychologist John L. Holland in the 1950s and is one of the most studied and validated professional orientation models in the world, with over 500 peer-reviewed studies.

The Inner Compass of the Five Spirits is an original NorthStar model that measures five fundamental inner qualities at work: Presence (moment awareness), Vision (future orientation), Instinct (intuition and speed), Focus (concentration and analysis) and Tenacity (resilience and determination).
Absolutely yes. Your test answers are anonymous by default. If you choose to register, your data is saved securely and never sold to third parties. You can delete your account at any time.

faq.q: Can I take the test multiple times?
faq.a: Yes. You can repeat the test at any time. People change over time and your inclinations can evolve with experience. If you have an account, each session is saved and you can compare results over time.

faq.q: Are salary and growth data up to date?
faq.a: Market data (average salaries, growth rate, AI risk) is based on annually updated sources (ISTAT, EUROSTAT, sector reports). Salary ranges represent the typical range for entry/mid/senior roles.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes how NorthStar collects, uses and protects the personal data of users who access the platform.
privacy.ctaDesc: We are available for any clarification on the processing of your personal data.
privacy.legalNoteText: This policy is an operational draft. Validation by a legal professional is recommended before final publication.
privacy.s1P1: The data controller is NorthStar, reachable at the dedicated privacy email address.
privacy.s1P2: For any request regarding the processing of your data, contact us at:
privacy.s2Intro: NorthStar only collects data necessary for the service to function:
s2Items: Registration data: name, email address, encrypted password.
Responses to orientation tests (RIASEC and Five Spirits) and related results.
Saved preferences: favourite sectors, saved articles, career goals.
Technical and usage data: IP address, browser type, pages visited, date and time of access.
Payment data: securely handled by Stripe; NorthStar does not store card details.
privacy.s3Intro: We process your data for the following purposes:

s3Bases.desc: Providing the service, managing the account, saving results and preferences.
Improving the platform, IT security, fraud prevention.
Sending marketing communications and newsletters, if explicitly authorised by the user.
Retention of accounting and tax data as required by law.

privacy.s4P1: NorthStar uses technical cookies necessary for the platform to function. We do not use third-party profiling cookies.
privacy.s4P2: Technical cookies do not require consent. You can manage cookie settings from your browser at any time.
privacy.s4BoxText: Session cookies (authentication), UI preference cookies (theme, language). No third-party tracking or marketing cookies.
privacy.s5Intro: Personal data is processed with adequate security measures and retained for the strictly necessary time:
s5Items: Account data: until the account is deleted by the user.
Test results: retained for the entire duration of the account, deleted on request.
Payment data: according to Stripe's policies and applicable tax obligations.
Technical logs: retained for a maximum of 90 days.
privacy.s6Intro: Personal data may only be shared with third parties in the following cases:
s6Items: Technical service providers (hosting, database, CDN) bound by confidentiality agreements.
Competent authorities, if required by law.
privacy.s6Footer: Data is not sold or transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.
privacy.s7Intro: Under the GDPR (EU Reg. 2016/679), you have the right to:

s7Rights.desc: Obtain a copy of your personal data.
Request the deletion of your data.
Receive data in a structured, readable format.
Object to processing based on legitimate interests or marketing.

privacy.s7Footer: To exercise your rights, write to privacy@northstar.app. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the data protection authority.
privacy.s8P1: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically to reflect regulatory or service changes.
privacy.s8P2: The updated version will always be available on this page with the date of last update indicated at the top.
